title: Hindu Reform Movements
definition: A series of 19th and 20th-century socio-religious initiatives aimed at purging Hindu society of medieval superstitions, caste-based discrimination, and gender inequality, while simultaneously synthesizing traditional Vedic wisdom with Western rationalism.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the 'Indian Renaissance', the evolution of Indian nationalism, and the roots of modern social legislation in India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Hindu Reform Movements.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
